config.record_grain: One current-name company record in an ASIC Company Register snapshot.

fields.evidence: Help file p.7: Company Name is the company name as it appears on the ASIC register; p.10 defines Current Name Indicator as flag that shown company name is current. Filter retains Y rows.
Help file p.7 defines ACN as a 9-digit Australian Company Number including leading zeroes, but states Type=RACN values are ARBNs; RACN is excluded.
Help file p.10 says ABN is the Australian Business Number for the company and is 0 when absent; the abn operation suppresses missing/0 and validates the identifier.

Help file pp.9-10 defines REGD as Registered, DRGD as De-registered, and EXAD as external administration (receivership/liquidation); other documented codes have no more-specific assignment ontology status.
Help file p.10 defines Date of Registration as the date on which a company was registered, with DD/MM/YYYY format.

Help file p.7 defines APTY as Australian proprietary company, APUB as Australian public company, and FNOS as a foreign company registered in Australia. RACN is not mapped because it is described as a registered corporation/organisation rather than explicitly as a company.

unmapped_fields.reason: Company liability-class codes (for example LMSH) have no corresponding canonical field; not inferred into entity type.
Company subclass codes have no corresponding canonical field and do not safely map to the limited entity_type enum.
No canonical deregistration-date field exists. It is not used to derive status because status is separately supplied.
Historical registration jurisdiction has no canonical field.
State-origin registration identifier has no matching canonical identifier field; preserved unmapped rather than retyped.
Dataset-change flag has no canonical field and does not state an observation timestamp.
Used only as a documented row filter to retain current-name records; no canonical field represents this flag.
Current-name history helper field is excluded with historical-name rows; no trading-name interpretation is supported.
Name-history effective date has no canonical field and must not be mapped to company registration date.

limitations: The source is a weekly snapshot, not a real-time register view; the supplied publication timestamp is used as the observation-time proxy (help file p.2).

The extract includes historical company-name records (help file p.2). The Current Name Indicator=Y filter intentionally selects only rows documented as showing the current company name; it excludes historical-name rows rather than treating them as trading names.
For Type=RACN, the ACN column is documented as an ARBN (help file p.7), which has no canonical field in this assignment; those rows cannot emit entity.acn.
Only the explicitly documented status codes REGD, DRGD, and EXAD receive specific ontology meanings. Other codes map to unknown; in particular, status is not inferred from Date of Deregistration.
Entity-type mapping is restricted to Type values explicitly described as companies. RACN remains unmapped as entity_type; no company type is inferred from a name suffix.
All confidence and source-reliability scores are provisional human-review judgements.
